section: B. Where the workflows break (folder flows)
method: 8 jobs walked by Playwright (scripts/j*.mjs, log-j*.json); every visible page-body control on 67 routes clicked on a fresh load (1,897 controls, sweep2.json); every distinct dialog opened and its primary pressed (74, modalsweep2.json); every distinct preview panel opened and each control clicked (54, panelsweep.json). Vanta step counts are read from help-center notes, not the live product.

findings.we_do: 52 of 74 distinct dialogs end with nothing changed: 25 close silently (the primary is a plain close button), 27 only toast. 22 of them mark fields Required and close anyway with the fields empty. On the chain: Plan an assessment, Publish assessment results, Set Ready, Add to assessment campaign, Create POA&M item, Change planned date, Create risk, Request acceptance, Record decision, Map control, Link evidence, Add evidence, Create requirement, Import requirements, Create task, Assign a role, Reassign reviewer, Share the package.
findings.vanta_does: Each step changes state and the next screen shows it: Upload → Draft → Submit for approval (disabled until a file is added) → approved → the linked test turns OK; a risk goes Draft → Needs review → Pending approval → Approved.
findings.fix: rebuild: give the chain's verbs real state changes (status, counts, My work), and mark the other dialogs 'not wired in the prototype' instead of a success toast

findings.we_do: All 11 My work rows land on their register unfiltered (findings All 44, risks All 40, evidence All 368, requests All 14, components All 52) with no record open. The top Urgent row's CVE isn't on the screen it lands on, and in Findings › Vulnerabilities its row opens nothing (dead end). Home's 'Open offer' lands on the Components register.
findings.vanta_does: A My work row opens a task-specific view, the register already filtered to the records the sentence counts: 2 clicks.
findings.fix: rebuild: each My work row and Home banner opens its register filtered to the records it counts, with the single record's preview open
vanta: V/pages/my-work-page.md 'How you get here / where it leads'

findings.we_do: The preview's '↗ Open the full record' does nothing on 46 of 54 previews (Control, Risk, Operational issue, POA&M item, Requirement, Person, Review, Task, Decision…). It works on 3 (Integration, Evidence, Policy).
findings.vanta_does: A record opens beside the list, and only records with their own work get a page; there is no full-record button that leads nowhere.
findings.fix: cut ↗ where the record has no page; wire it where one exists
vanta: V/README.md 'What makes it feel simple' point 4

findings.we_do: A control from nothing can't move: SA-24's preview primary 'Map a requirement', the Controls header 'Map a requirement' and 'Add a note…' do nothing, and only SI-2 has a control record. SI-2's 'Open assessment campaign' opens the Assessments list, not the campaign it names.
findings.vanta_does: The control's side panel carries Tests '+', Documents '+' and 'AI suggests 15 tests · Add all'; the status turns OK as tests and documents pass, in about 5 steps without leaving the register.
findings.fix: rebuild: the control preview's next step opens its picker (Map a requirement, Link evidence, Add to assessment campaign) and the status moves when it is done

findings.we_do: The two real state changes don't reach the other screens that show them. After SSP 3 is submitted ('In review, locked'; Plans says In review), My work still says 'Submit SSP 3 for review · Draft', Review doesn't list it (still 148) and Authorization still says Draft. After 'Reassign all to Nadia Fournier' on Victor's offboarding page, Privileged access reviews and People still name Victor.
findings.vanta_does: An approval flips the dependent test to OK and the counts and My work follow by themselves; the chain is one set of records.
findings.fix: rebuild: drive My work, Review, Authorization and People from the same state the SSP and offboarding pages change
vanta: V/README.md 'What makes it feel simple' points 5–6

findings.we_do: After Create program, PRG-2301's page keeps WS-X90's switcher, menu highlight and badges (Evidence 142, Getting started 25%). Its starter guide's Open requirements, Connect, Open the SSP and Open assessments open WS-X90's pages. Once you leave, the program is gone (Programs All 9, not on Home, not in the switcher).
findings.vanta_does: One workspace at a time, with the switcher in the top bar; the Starter guide's steps open their pages inside that workspace.
findings.fix: rebuild: make the new program the current program (switcher, menu, links) and add it to Programs, Home and the switcher
vanta: V/README.md 'What makes it feel simple' point 3

findings.we_do: Counts disagree between screens: '4 campaigns · 2 active' vs tab 'Active 3'; 'Requests 368' vs table 'All 14' (the tracker reuses the Evidence register's 88/54/226); 'Open CVEs 1' vs '4 open'; Checks '7 checks' vs 'All 5'; menu 'Evidence 142' vs register 'All 368'; Review 'Evidence to accept 96' vs Evidence 'Pending review 88'; SI-2 'Findings None' vs tab 'Findings 1'; 'Acceptance: Not requested' vs 'Request sent on Nov 17'; 'Version 2 ready to submit' vs '1 of 3'.
findings.vanta_does: One number first and each line is a filter, so a count and the list it opens agree.
findings.fix: rebuild: compute each count from the rows it opens; cut counts that have no list behind them
vanta: V/README.md 'What makes it feel simple' point 1

findings.we_do: Ten registers arrive with rows already ticked ('2 selected' / '3 selected') and the selection bar's bulk verbs live, so a bulk action would act on rows the person never chose.
findings.vanta_does: The register arrives with nothing ticked; the selection bar replaces the filters only once rows are checked.
findings.fix: cut the pre-ticked rows; show the selection bar only after a choice

findings.we_do: Page header actions that do nothing: Findings 'Create operational issue' and 'Import scan'; Controls 'Map a requirement' and 'Export ▾'; Checks 'Run all now' and 'Create check'; Inventory 'Import scan' and 'Add asset'; Frameworks & overlays 'Import OSCAL' and 'Create overlay'; Data calls 'Import data call' and 'Review conflicts'; Suppliers 'Import SBOM'; Overview '⋯ More program actions'; Package room 'Edit version 2'; plus 7 Exports.
findings.vanta_does: The header holds one primary and More, and both open something.
findings.fix: rebuild: every header primary opens its dialog; cut the ones the prototype won't draw
vanta: V/README.md 'What makes it feel simple' point 2

findings.we_do: Required fields aren't enforced: 22 dialogs that mark fields Required close anyway when the fields are empty. Evidence › Upload › Add evidence with no file toasts 'Added, pending review'.
findings.vanta_does: Submit stays disabled until a file is added; Next stays disabled until the step is valid.
findings.fix: rebuild: hold the primary until the required fields are filled, and name the missing field

findings.we_do: Fix links land at the top of a long page or on a list. The SSP readiness fixes ('Draft a rationale' and 6 more) open the editor at the top, with section 2 neither in view nor focused. SI-2's 'Open assessment campaign' opens the Assessments list. Home's 'Open offer' opens the Components register.
findings.vanta_does: Cards and rows open the page 'with filtered views to take immediate action'.
findings.fix: move: deep-link each fix to its section, record or filtered list

findings.we_do: Finding → POA&M → risk has no link to the risk: neither the issue preview nor the POA&M item preview shows it, so you find 'Risk arising from REQ-100' by name. The issue offers 'Create POA&M item' although it already lists its POA&M item.
findings.vanta_does: A risk scenario maps its issues, controls and tasks; a control lists its linked issues.
findings.fix: merge: show the risk on the issue and POA&M previews; replace Create POA&M item with Open POA&M item when one exists

findings.we_do: Onboarding has no start: People has no Add person, 'Assign a role' (existing people only) closes silently, and the onboarding page's 9 task rows can't be opened or completed.
findings.vanta_does: Add a personnel record or sync from the IdP; tasks come from the person's group, the person completes them on their onboarding page, and Task status updates.
findings.fix: rebuild: an Add person dialog that starts the onboarding task set, with each task row opening and completing

screens: People › Privileged access reviews › Access review preview
findings.we_do: Keep and Revoke don't move '11 of 18 decided'; 'Complete review' does nothing and says nothing.
findings.vanta_does: Submit is allowed once every account has an owner and a decision, and Complete once every Deny or Change has evidence.
findings.fix: rebuild: decisions update the counts, and Complete says what is still owed

findings.we_do: The wizard says categorization is in 'step 2' and the baseline is 'Chosen in step 3'; the stepper has Systems at 3 and Baseline at 4.
findings.vanta_does: Multi-step modals say 'Step 1 of 3' and refer to their own steps.
findings.fix: restyle: correct the two step references to step 3 and step 4

findings.we_do: Home has no Create program; its footnote says it sits in the program switcher's menu, which only exists inside a program (Programs has it).
findings.vanta_does: The empty Home has one primary.
findings.fix: move: put Create program in Home's header beside View my work

findings.we_do: Preview actions that do nothing: Control 'Open assessment findings' (AC-1's next step) and 'Add a note…'; Asset 'Edit asset'; Inheritance 'Ask Priya Raghavan'; Risk 'More'; Lifecycle gate 'Add security outcomes' (toast 'The security outcome picker opens here').
findings.vanta_does: A side panel's actions add or open the linked record in place.
findings.fix: cut or rebuild each preview action so it opens its target

jobs.works: offboarding steps change state; Close says what is still owed
